message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build / Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ '**', '!pre.*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

env:
  BUILD_TYPE: Release

jobs:
  build:
    permissions: write-all
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        config:
#          - os: ubuntu-22.04
          - os: windows-2022
          - os: macos-15-intel

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      with:
        submodules: true

    - name: Select Python 3.10 # otherwise turtlebrowser/get-conan@v1.1 fails on macos-12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'

    - name: Install Conan
      id: conan
      uses: turtlebrowser/get-conan@main

    - name: Cache Conan dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.conan
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-conan-${{ hashFiles('conan.lock', 'conanfile.txt', 'conanfile.py') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-conan-

    - name: Configure CMake
      run: cmake -B ${{github.workspace}}/_build -S ${{github.workspace}} -DCMAKE_PROJECT_TOP_LEVEL_INCLUDES=${{github.workspace}}/build.props/conan_provider.cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{env.BUILD_TYPE}}

    - name: Build
      run: cmake --build ${{github.workspace}}/_build --config ${{env.BUILD_TYPE}} --parallel 4

    - name: Test
      working-directory: ${{github.workspace}}/_build
      run: ctest -C ${{env.BUILD_TYPE}} -VV",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds with CMake/Conan on Windows and macOS and re-fetches dependencies on every run. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports caching dependency downloads to save CI resources while keeping all build/test steps intact. Adding an actions/cache step for the Conan home (~/.conan), keyed on the lockfile/manifest with OS restore keys, preserves coverage (a cache miss still performs a full configure/build/test) and adds no secrets, deployment, publishing, or privileged actions. Job permissions are left unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
